title: Bob's Discs
description: 7 New Custom Music Discs for your jukebox!
body:
**_This mod adds a whopping 7 brand new musical discs that shall be played on your jukebox._**
**All of these pieces are made by yours truly, specifically for this modification.**
All of these records can be crafted on thy workbench, _and one is made by letting the flames of your furnace consume an iron ingot, melting it once more._
 **_There are three advancements you shall earn. Two you get by collecting specific discs, and one you achieve by gaining all of these compositions._**
